message: Real Payapang Isip tools, real AI Music audio, a cleaner homepage, and a working featured slider.

changelog.title: Payapang Isip Real
changelog.desc: Totoong breathing at journal data na ang ginagamit ng page—local user entries at real interaction state, hindi fake mock content.

changelog.title: AI Music Real Audio
changelog.desc: AI Music now uses real generated audio from the MusicGen service and a live Web Audio analyser visualizer instead of placeholder audio.

changelog.title: Homepage Video Removed
changelog.desc: Tinanggal ang lumang bottom homepage video section para mas malinis at mas focused ang home page.

changelog.title: Homepage Sliding
changelog.desc: Gumagana na ang featured homepage slider para sa Payapang Isip, AI Music, CTRLZONE, Shop, Feeds, Global Chat, at News.
